data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC extends winning streak, ETH clears key hurdle, XRP steadies | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) begin the week on a firm footing after surging over 1%, 4% and 1%, respectively, in the previous week. BTC holds above key technical resistance after recording its fourth consecutive weekly gain.
